import { useParams, useLocation } from 'react-router-dom';
import { customerApi, invoiceApi, paymentApi } from '@services/api';
import CustomerModal from '@components/features/CustomerModal';
import InvoiceModal from '@components/features/InvoiceModal';
import EditInvoiceModal from '@components/features/EditInvoiceModal';

export default function CustomerDashboard() {
  const { customerId } = useParams();
  const location = useLocation();
  const [customer, setCustomer] = useState(location.state?.customer || null);
  const [invoices, setInvoices] = useState([]);
  const [isCustomerModalOpen, setIsCustomerModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isInvoiceModalOpen, setIsInvoiceModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isEditModalOpen, setIsEditModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [selectedInvoice, setSelectedInvoice] = useState(null);
  const [selectedPayment, setSelectedPayment] = useState(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (customerId) {
      loadCustomerInvoices(customerId);
    }
  }, [customerId]);

  const loadCustomerInvoices = async (custId) => {
    const invoiceList = await invoiceApi.getByCustomer(custId);

    const invoicesWithPayments = await Promise.all(
      invoiceList.map(async (invoice) => {
        const payment = await paymentApi.getByInvoice(invoice.invoice_number);
        return {
          ...invoice,
          payment,
          payment_id: payment?.payment_id || null
        };
      })
    );

    setInvoices(invoicesWithPayments);
  };

  const handleUpdateCustomer = async (customerData) => {
    try {
      const updated = await customerApi.update(customer.customer_id, customerData);
      setCustomer(updated);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error updating customer:', error);
    }
  };

  const handleCreateInvoice = async (invoiceData) => {
    try {
      await invoiceApi.create(invoiceData);
      await loadCustomerInvoices(customerId);
    } catch (error) {
      throw error;
    }
  };

  const handleEditInvoice = (invoice) => {
    setSelectedInvoice(invoice);
    setSelectedPayment({
      payment_id: invoice.payment_id,
      payment_status: invoice.payment?.payment_status,
      payment_date: invoice.payment?.payment_date
    });
    setIsEditModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleSaveInvoice = async (updatedInvoice, updatedPayment) => {
    try {
      await invoiceApi.update(selectedInvoice.invoice_number, updatedInvoice);

      if (selectedPayment?.payment_id) {
        await paymentApi.update(selectedPayment.payment_id, updatedPayment);
      } else if (updatedPayment.payment_status || updatedPayment.payment_date) {
        await paymentApi.create({
          invoice_id: selectedInvoice.invoice_number,
          payment_status: updatedPayment.payment_status || 'pending',
          payment_date: updatedPayment.payment_date
        });
      }

      await loadCustomerInvoices(customerId);
    } catch (error) {
      throw error;
    }
  };

  const formatDate = (dateStr) => {
    if (!dateStr) return '—';
    const date = new Date(dateStr);
    return date.toLocaleDateString();
  };

  const formatCurrency = (value) => {
    return `$${parseFloat(value).toFixed(2)}`;
  };

  if (!customer) {
    return (
      <div className="page">
        <div className="main-container">
          <p>Loading customer...</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="page">
      <div className="main-container dashboard-container">
        <div className="dashboard-top">
          <div className="dashboard-info-card">
            <div className="dashboard-header">
              <div>
                <h1>{customer.name || 'Customer'}</h1>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="dashboard-info">
              <div className="info-row">
                <span>Phone</span>
                <strong>{customer.phone || '—'}</strong>
              </div>
              <div className="info-row">
                <span>Email</span>
                <strong>{customer.email || '—'}</strong>
              </div>
              <div className="info-row">
                <span>Address</span>
                <strong>{customer.address || '—'}</strong>
              </div>
              <div className="info-row">
                <span>Notes</span>
                <strong>{customer.notes || '—'}</strong>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="dashboard-actions-card">
            <div className="dashboard-actions">
              <div className="dashboard-action-row">
                <button
                  className="btn-secondary"
                  onClick={() => setIsCustomerModalOpen(true)}
                >
                  Update Customer
                </button>
                <button className="btn-secondary danger">Delete Customer</button>
              </div>
              <button
                className="btn-primary full-width"
                onClick={() => setIsInvoiceModalOpen(true)}
              >
                Generate New Invoice
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="dashboard-bottom">
          <div className="dashboard-table-wrapper">
            <table className="dashboard-table">
              <thead>
                <tr>
                  <th>Invoice #</th>
                  <th>Month</th>
                  <th>Base Price</th>
                  <th>GST</th>
                  <th>QST</th>
                  <th>Total</th>
                  <th>Payment Status</th>
                  <th>Payment Date</th>
                  <th></th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {invoices.length === 0 ? (
                  <tr>
                    <td colSpan="9" className="table-empty">
                      Invoices will appear here.
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ) : (
                  invoices.map((invoice) => {
                    const paymentStatus = invoice.payment?.payment_status || '—';
                    const paymentDate = invoice.payment?.payment_date
                      ? formatDate(invoice.payment.payment_date)
                      : '—';

                    return (
                      <tr key={invoice.invoice_number}>
                        <td>{invoice.invoice_number}</td>
                        <td>{formatDate(invoice.month)}</td>
                        <td>{formatCurrency(invoice.base_price)}</td>
                        <td>{formatCurrency(invoice.gst)}</td>
                        <td>{formatCurrency(invoice.qst)}</td>
                        <td>{formatCurrency(invoice.total_price)}</td>
                        <td>
                          <span className={`payment-status status-${paymentStatus}`}>
                            {paymentStatus}
                          </span>
                        </td>
                        <td>{paymentDate}</td>
                        <td>
                          <button
                            className="btn-icon"
                            onClick={() => handleEditInvoice(invoice)}
                            title="Edit invoice"
                          >
                            ✎
                          </button>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    );
                  })
                )}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <CustomerModal
        isOpen={isCustomerModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsCustomerModalOpen(false)}
        onSave={handleUpdateCustomer}
        customer={customer}
      />
      <InvoiceModal
        isOpen={isInvoiceModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsInvoiceModalOpen(false)}
        onSave={handleCreateInvoice}
        customerId={customer.customer_id}

      <EditInvoiceModal

        onClose={() => setIsEditModalOpen(false)}
        onSave={handleSaveInvoice}
        invoice={selectedInvoice}
        payment={selectedPayment}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
